item.title: Is the AI Bubble Real? A Wall Street Veteran's Cold Take
item.description: Amid the red-hot AI investment frenzy, a Wall Street veteran offers a different perspective: we might be experiencing a new tech bubble. From power bottlenecks to regulatory blind spots, this article breaks down the potential risks behind the AI hype in plain English.

item.title: Stop Copy-Pasting: Cursor CLI Puts an AI Coding Agent Right in Your Terminal
item.description: Say goodbye to constant context switching between browser and terminal. Cursor CLI injects a powerful AI Agent into your command line for chat-style code generation, file operations, code reviews, and CI/CD automation—keeping you in flow whether you're on SSH, Vim/Neovim, local, or remote.

item.title: Zhipu AI GLM-4.5 Release: New Benchmark Challenging GPT-4's AI Coding Capabilities
item.description: Zhipu AI releases GLM-4.5 series models with 355B parameters, surpassing GPT-4.1 in SWE-bench tests, ranking 3rd globally in AI benchmarks, supporting code generation, PPT creation, and full-stack development capabilities.
